nodes.Name: spanSet
nodes.DocComment:
A spanSet is a set of *mspans.

spanSet is safe for concurrent push and pop operations.

Fields.Name: spineCap
Fields.DocComment: Spine array cap, accessed under spineLock

nodes.Name: push
nodes.DocComment:
push adds span s to buffer b. push is safe to call concurrently
with other push and pop operations.

nodes.Name: pop
nodes.DocComment:
pop removes and returns a span from buffer b, or nil if b is empty.
pop is safe to call concurrently with other pop and push operations.

nodes.Name: reset
nodes.DocComment:
reset resets a spanSet which is empty. It will also clean up
any left over blocks.

Throws if the buf is not empty.

reset may not be called concurrently with any other operations
on the span set.

nodes.Name: atomicSpanSetSpinePointer
nodes.DocComment:
atomicSpanSetSpinePointer is an atomically-accessed spanSetSpinePointer.

It has the same semantics as atomic.UnsafePointer.

nodes.Name: Load
nodes.DocComment:
Loads the spanSetSpinePointer and returns it.

It has the same semantics as atomic.UnsafePointer.

nodes.Name: StoreNoWB
nodes.DocComment:
Stores the spanSetSpinePointer.

It has the same semantics as [atomic.UnsafePointer].

nodes.Name: spanSetSpinePointer
nodes.DocComment: spanSetSpinePointer represents a pointer to a contiguous block of atomic.Pointer[spanSetBlock].

nodes.Name: lookup
nodes.DocComment: lookup returns &s[idx].

nodes.Name: spanSetBlockPool
nodes.DocComment: spanSetBlockPool is a global pool of spanSetBlocks.

nodes.Name: spanSetBlockAlloc
nodes.DocComment: spanSetBlockAlloc represents a concurrent pool of spanSetBlocks.

nodes.Name: alloc
nodes.DocComment:
alloc tries to grab a spanSetBlock out of the pool, and if it fails
persistentallocs a new one and returns it.

nodes.Name: free
nodes.DocComment: free returns a spanSetBlock back to the pool.

nodes.Name: headTailIndex
nodes.DocComment:
headTailIndex represents a combined 32-bit head and 32-bit tail
of a queue into a single 64-bit value.

nodes.Name: makeHeadTailIndex
nodes.DocComment:
makeHeadTailIndex creates a headTailIndex value from a separate
head and tail.

nodes.Name: head
nodes.DocComment: head returns the head of a headTailIndex value.

nodes.Name: tail
nodes.DocComment: tail returns the tail of a headTailIndex value.

nodes.Name: split
nodes.DocComment: split splits the headTailIndex value into its parts.

nodes.Name: atomicHeadTailIndex
nodes.DocComment: atomicHeadTailIndex is an atomically-accessed headTailIndex.

nodes.Name: load
nodes.DocComment: load atomically reads a headTailIndex value.

nodes.Name: cas
nodes.DocComment: cas atomically compares-and-swaps a headTailIndex value.

nodes.Name: incHead
nodes.DocComment: incHead atomically increments the head of a headTailIndex.

nodes.Name: decHead
nodes.DocComment: decHead atomically decrements the head of a headTailIndex.

nodes.Name: incTail
nodes.DocComment: incTail atomically increments the tail of a headTailIndex.

nodes.Name: reset
nodes.DocComment: reset clears the headTailIndex to (0, 0).

nodes.Name: atomicMSpanPointer
nodes.DocComment: atomicMSpanPointer is an atomic.Pointer[mspan]. Can't use generics because it's NotInHeap.

nodes.Name: Load
nodes.DocComment: Load returns the *mspan.

nodes.Name: StoreNoWB
nodes.DocComment: StoreNoWB stores an *mspan.
